ns2:section.sectionText: This section is reserved for students in Agricultural education programs, Foreign Languages, Secondary and Continuing Education, Classics and the teaching of English Programs. It will meet during the first five weeks of the semester. You are then required to register for SPED 405, Section FLA, CRN 35339, or SPED 405 FLA, Section S1, CRN 35774 (which will meet during the remaining ten weeks of the semester.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Secondary & Continuing Educ or Teaching of Russian or Teaching of German or Teaching of Spanish or Classics or English or Teaching of Latin major(s).
